comments.body:
Thanks @pcbeingused333! This fixes #198 the same way as your #205, which is already merged (`5c17d6c`), so on current `main` this PR conflicts in `agentToolUtils.test.ts` and its change is already in. Did you mean this as an alternative to #205, or did it just go out after the merge?

If it is the second, we'll close it. If you meant it as a change on top of #205 (for example keeping the disallowed names in `IN_PROCESS_TEAMMATE_DISALLOWED_TOOLS` in `src/constants/tools.ts` instead of the inline check), say so and rebase it onto `main`.

For next time: before starting on an issue, check whether a PR for it is already open or merged, and say on the issue that you're taking it. That keeps two PRs from landing for the same change.

Thanks for checking. It was the second case: this went out after #205 merged, and no change on top of it is intended, so please go ahead and close it. Sorry for the noise; I will check for merged PRs on an issue before opening one next time.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
Thanks for confirming, @pcbeingused333. Closing as a duplicate of #205, which is already merged.
